palette.note: Sequential ramps stay within one colour family (values): earth for money, violet for ownership, plum for social data, ink for density. If a view has fewer classes than a ramp has colours, the viewer samples the ramp evenly. Named colours follow Joost Grootens' atlases and are for categories.
